title: Versioned Next.js snippet set with labels
note: `--check` passes, but `tests/test_corpus.py` and `tests/fixtures/docs` do not exist, so the spec's record-invariant and determinism criteria are unproven.

title: FastAPI service holding the pipeline and its per-query trace
note: Covered by `tests/test_api.py` (20 passed). Untested criterion: `/health` with a missing `.npy`.

title: Gate 1: in-scope check, version routing, injection refusal
note: Covered by `tests/test_scope.py` (20 passed). Untested criteria: scope threshold boundary 0.50, injection precedence order, bad-router 502.

title: BM25 + dense retrieval returning ~30 chunks with fused ranking
note: Covered by `tests/test_retrieve.py` (20 passed). Untested criteria: 24-chunk short slice, embedding-call count.

title: Gate 2: per-chunk relevance/currency scoring, threshold, zero-pass stop
note: Covered by `tests/test_rerank.py` (20 passed). Untested criterion: decision-call question count.

title: Chat model writes the cited answer from the kept chunks
note: Live 2026-11-15 on both policies: strict trace `outcome=answered`, `synthesize latency_ms=1899.79 tokens_in=1343`, `list_cost_usd=0.0025305`; fast_fix `answered` with 5/5 sentences verified. `uv run pytest -q` → 57 passed. No SPEC-synthesis.md exists yet: SPEC-map lists it as planned.

title: Gate 3: per-sentence support check, one repair pass, flag or answer
note: Live 2026-11-15 on both policies, from the same strict trace as `synthesis`: `synthesize latency_ms=1899.79 tokens_in=1343`, `verify latency_ms=381.788`, `list_cost_usd=0.0025305`, every sentence verdict `verified`; fast_fix verified 5/5. `uv run pytest -q` → 57 passed. No SPEC-gate-verify.md exists yet.

title: 40 labelled queries through three pipelines with a written scorecard
note: Live 2026-11-15, `uv run python -m eval.harness` → 120 records (384 calls) in `eval/results.json`, no error. Cited-gold on the 30 answerable queries: strict 0.667, fast_fix 0.867, no_gates 0.867; on the 23 official-doc queries all three tie at 0.870. Scorecard at `eval/scorecard.md`; `uv run pytest -q` → 66 passed in 0.50s.
